title: Need a clear picture of the evidence?
text: Get a focused synthesis of what is known about your climate question, where findings agree and which uncertainties matter for your decision. An independent scientific review can help you assess a claim, interpret new research or plan your next steps.

title: Overwhelmed by the choice of climate data?
text: Which predictions or projections are useful for your location, timescale and question? I help you choose and interpret appropriate datasets, then acquire and process the data for your analysis, including local information and tailored indicators.

title: Need to see how the answer changes?
text: Give your team a clear way to compare scenarios, test assumptions and explore the thresholds that matter to a decision. A custom interactive tool can make a complex dataset or calculation easier to use and discuss.

title: Need to bring your team or audience up to speed?
text: Help people make sense of Arctic climate, sea ice or carbon management through a talk or workshop built around their questions. We can work through the science and the numbers together, at a level suited to the audience.
